entities.title: Make MEG a game on icelander.net
entities.summary: Turn the static page into a game like the others: an npm project with a Worker that serves it under icelander.net/games/retro/meg behind the shared sign-in.
acceptanceCriteria: games/meg has a package.json, build, tests and wrangler.jsonc, so the deploy workflow builds and deploys it.
The Worker checks icelander.net's sign-in with vendor/icelander-auth/, as the other games' Workers do.
The root README lists MEG with its play link.

origin.description: The owner had MEG built in a Claude session and asked for it to be put in a folder in this repository.
